items.reason: The record says 'Glioblastoma, IDH-wildtype or IDH-mutant', which explicitly allows IDH-mutant glioblastoma (historical). It neither requires IDH-wildtype nor cites WHO CNS 2021, so the cns5 criteria are not met and the 'both' tie-break does not apply, despite CNS5-style subtype names.

SMARCB1 loss defines only the non-GBM malignant rhabdoid tumour cohort ('Loss of SMARCB1 confirmed by immunohistochemistry'), and is one optional diagnostic route (D31-A2); GBM patients enter without it.
